description.zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
* **true**（默认）：是。
* **false**：否。

> 使用优惠券后，若需要进行降配操作，由代金券抵扣的金额将不会进行退款。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* **true** (default): Automatically uses coupons.
* **false**: Does not automatically use coupons.

> After a coupon is used, the amount deducted by the coupon is not refunded if you downgrade the instance.

description.zh:
[高性能云盘IO性能突发功能](~~2340501~~)开关，取值：

- **true**：开启。
- **false**：关闭。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the [I/O performance burst feature for premium performance disks](~~2340501~~). Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

description.zh:
实例系列，取值：

- **Basic**：基础系列
- **HighAvailability**：高可用系列
- **cluster**：集群系列
description.en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

- **Basic**: Basic Edition
- **HighAvailability**: High-availability Edition
- **cluster**: Cluster Edition

description.zh:
<props="china">通用云盘[数据归档功能](~~2701832~~)，取值：</props>

- <props="china">**true**：开启</props>

- <props="china">**false**：关闭</props>

<props="intl">预留参数。</props>
description.en:
<props="china">Specifies whether to enable the [cold data archiving feature](~~2701832~~) for general-purpose cloud disks. Valid values:</props>

- <props="china">**true**: Enabled.</props>

- <props="china">**false**: Disabled.</props>

<props="intl">Reserved parameter.</props>

description.zh: 实例规格。详情请参见[实例规格](~~26312~~)。
description.en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

description.zh: 实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
description.en: The instance ID. You can call [DescribeDBInstances](~~2628785~~) to query the instance ID.

description.zh:
[目标存储空间大小](~~26312~~)，单位GB，可调用[DescribeAvailableClasses](~~610393~~)接口查询目标实例规格中可用的存储空间范围。

> * 本参数和**DBInstanceClass**参数两者至少传入一项。
> * 调用[DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~610394~~)可以查看实例当前的存储空间大小。
description.en:
The [target storage capacity](~~26312~~), in GB. You can call the [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~610393~~) operation to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

> * You must specify at least one of this parameter and the **DBInstanceClass** parameter.
> * You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~610394~~) operation to query the current storage capacity of the instance.

description.zh:
实例存储类型，取值：

* **general_essd**：高性能云盘（推荐）
* **cloud_essd**：ESSD PL1云盘
* **cloud_essd2**：ESSD PL2云盘
* **cloud_essd3**：ESSD PL3云盘
description.en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:

* **general_essd**: premium performance disk (recommended)
* **cloud_essd**: PL1 ESSD
* **cloud_essd2**: PL2 ESSD
* **cloud_essd3**: PL3 ESSD

description.zh: 节点信息。
description.en: The node information.

description.zh:
节点的唯一标识，用于指定节点。
> 仅对集群版实例有效。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the node, used to specify a node.
> This parameter is valid only for Cluster Edition instances.

description.zh:
节点类型。返回值：
* **Master**：主节点。
* **Slave**：备节点。

> 集群版实例可不填入，通过填入NodeId参数确定节点。
description.en:
The node type. Valid values:
* **Master**: primary node.
* **Slave**: secondary node.

> For Cluster Edition instances, you can leave this parameter empty and specify the NodeId parameter to identify the node.

description.zh: 实例虚拟交换机ID。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the instance.

description.zh: 可用区ID。
description.en: The zone ID.

description.zh:
实例变配类型，取值：

- **Up**（默认值）：包年包月实例的升级和按量付费实例的升级/降级。
- **Down**：包年包月实例的降级。
description.en:
The type of specification change for the instance. Valid values:

- **Up** (default): Upgrades a subscription instance, or upgrades/downgrades a pay-as-you-go instance.
- **Down**: Downgrades a subscription instance.

description.zh:
新配置生效时间，取值：
> **变更部分配置可能对实例产生影响**，请仔细阅读[功能文档内的影响章节](~~96061~~)，再配置该参数，建议在业务低峰期进行。
* **Immediate**（默认值）：立即生效。
* **MaintainTime**：在[可运维时间段内](~~610402~~)生效。
* **ScheduleTime**：指定时间切换。该时间需为当前时间12小时之后的一个时刻，且实际切换时间遵循EffectiveTime=ScheduleTime+SwitchTime。
description.en:
The effective period for the new configurations. Valid values:
> **Changing some configurations may affect the instance**. Read the impact section in the [feature documentation](~~96061~~) before you configure this parameter. Perform the operation during off-peak hours.
* **Immediate** (default): The new configurations take effect immediately.
* **MaintainTime**: The new configurations take effect during the [maintenance window](~~610402~~).
* **ScheduleTime**: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime. Allocate sufficient time for the switchover.

description.zh:
高性能云盘[Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能](~~2527067~~)，取值：

-  **1**：开启
-  **0**：不开启
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature](~~2527067~~) for premium performance disks. Valid values:

- **1**: enabled
- **0**: not enabled

description.zh: 参数模板ID。
description.en: The parameter template ID.

description.zh:
参数及其值，参数的值都是字符串类型。可调用DescribeParameterTemplates查询参数名称和参数值。

>传入参数**ParameterGroupId**，如果ParameterGroupId参数与Parameters参数共同修改了某个参数，则优先使用Parameters参数的改动。
description.en:
The parameters and their values. All parameter values are of the STRING type. You can call the DescribeParameterTemplates operation to query parameter names and values.

> If you specify the **ParameterGroupId** parameter and both ParameterGroupId and Parameters modify the same parameter, the value specified in Parameters takes precedence.

description.zh: 优惠券code。
description.en: The coupon code.

description.zh: 资源组名称
description.en: The resource group name.

description.zh: 指定修改参数的执行时间。需要EffectiveTime取值ScheduleTime。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 >该时间必须大于当前时间（执行调用的时间）。
description.en: The time at which the parameter modification is executed. The EffectiveTime parameter must be set to ScheduleTime. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). > The time must be later than the current time (the time when the call is made).

description.zh:
PostgreSQL实例[内核小版本号](~~126002~~)。当变更实例规格并且报错内核小版本不支持时，需要传入内核小版本号，**用于在变更实例规格时升级内核小版本**。

格式：`rds_postgres_<大版本号>00_<小版本号>`。例如12版本的20200830：`rds_postgres_1200_20200830`。
description.en:
The [minor engine version](~~126002~~) of the PostgreSQL instance. If the specification change fails because the current minor engine version is not supported, specify the minor engine version to **upgrade the minor engine version during the specification change**.

Format: `rds_postgres_<MajorVersion>00_<MinorVersion>`. Example for version 12 with minor version 20200830: `rds_postgres_1200_20200830`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-db-instance --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --auto-use-coupon true --promotion-code aliwood-1688-mobile-promotion --effective-time Immediate --switch-time 2019-10-17T18:50:00Z --db-instance-id pgm-bp15i4hn07r000000 --db-instance-class pg.n4.2c.1m --db-instance-storage 500 --db-instance-storage-type cloud_essd --direction Up --category Standard --bursting-enabled false --io-acceleration-enabled 0 --cold-data-enabled true --target-minor-version rds_postgres_1200_20200830 --db-nodes Role=Master ZoneId=cn-shanghai-e VSwitchId=vsw-bp1g7uym6ia6yroes6dkm NodeId=28542293 --parameters key=example-string --parameter-group-id rpg-dp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstance --region cn-hangzhou --BurstingEnabled false --ColdDataEnabled true --Category Standard --Parameters '{"key":"example-string"}' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --EffectiveTime Immediate --DBInstanceClass 'pg.n4.2c.1m' --PromotionCode 'aliwood-1688-mobile-promotion' --DBInstanceStorageType cloud_essd --Direction Up --ParameterGroupId 'rpg-dp0000' --AutoUseCoupon true --DBInstanceId 'pgm-bp15i4hn07r000000' --TargetMinorVersion rds_postgres_1200_20200830 --DBNodes '[{"Role":"Master","ZoneId":"cn-shanghai-e","VSwitchId":"vsw-bp1g7uym6ia6yroes6dkm","NodeId":"28542293"}]' --DBInstanceStorage 500 --SwitchTime '2019-10-17T18:50:00Z' --IoAccelerationEnabled 0
